note: Reference outputs for Exercise 3. Values such as confidence and rationale wording will vary between runs and between models; the shape and the enum values must not.

missing_information: Order number or approximate purchase date
Whether the pole failed at a joint or mid-span
CTG-10421.rationale: A snapped pole prevents setup, so the tent cannot be used, but nobody is described as at risk. Model and purchase details are missing.

missing_information: Fuel canister type and whether it is still attached
CTG-10422.rationale: Customer reports a flare-up, a burn injury, and a valve that hisses when closed. Injury plus a possible fuel leak requires safety review before any reply.

missing_information: What the customer needs help with
CTG-10425.rationale: The message contains no support request. Ask what the customer needs rather than assigning a category.

common_compliance_failures: Wrapping the JSON in a markdown code fence or adding a closing sentence
Returning confidence as "58%" or "high" instead of a number
Inventing an extra field such as suggested_reply
Using severity values like "high" or "P1" that are not in the enum
Setting safety_flag true while leaving severity at s3_normal
